name: Vehicle Ownership Transfer
description: Transfer of vehicle registration from the seller to the buyer. Required by law within 14 days of vehicle sale within the same state.
prerequisites: Vehicle must have active insurance and active PUCC. If there is an active loan, NOC from the bank (Form 35) is mandatory.
common_steps: Obtain a No Objection Certificate (NOC) from the seller's RTO if the buyer resides in a different RTO jurisdiction.
Fill out Form 29 (Notice of Transfer) and Form 30 (Application for Transfer) online on Vahan Parivahan.
Upload scanned documents: Original RC, signed Form 29 & 30, Valid Insurance, PUCC, Buyer's address proof, and Bank NOC (Form 35) if applicable.
Pay the ownership transfer fee online.
Submit the physical application file (original RC, physical Form 29 & 30, chassis pencil print, insurance/PUCC copies) to the RTO.
The RTO verifies the records and issues a new Registration Certificate (RC) smart card in the buyer's name.

DL.fee_breakdown: Transfer Fee: ₹300 (Motorcycle) or ₹500 (Car). Smart Card Fee: ₹200. Total: ₹500 - ₹700.
DL.test_format: Contactless. Signed Forms 29 and 30 are verified via e-sign/Aadhaar OTP of both seller and buyer. No RTO visit needed.
DL.special_note: Aadhaar linked mobile numbers are required for both seller and buyer for contactless validation.

MH.fee_breakdown: Transfer Fee: ₹150 (Motorcycle), ₹300 (Car). Smart Card: ₹200. Transfer tax check applies.
MH.test_format: Physical submission. Online application is done, but the original RC and pencil impression of the chassis number must be submitted physically at the RTO.
MH.special_note: Ensure the chassis print is clearly readable on Form 30 using a pencil rub.

KA.fee_breakdown: Transfer Fee: ₹150 (Motorcycle), ₹300 (Car). Smart Card: ₹200. Urban cess and checkpost taxes might apply.
KA.test_format: Physical file submission. Buyer and seller signatures on Forms 29 & 30 must match the RTO signatures database.
KA.special_note: If signatures mismatch, both buyer and seller might be called to RTO for verification.

documents: Form 29 (Notice of Transfer - 2 copies, signed by seller & buyer)
Buyer's Address Proof (Aadhaar, Voter ID, or Passport)
Pencil print of the Chassis Number (rubbed onto a piece of paper and stuck on the form)
General.additional_notes: If the vehicle is financed by a bank, you must provide Form 35 (NOC for hypothecation termination) signed by the bank.

faqs.question: What is Form 29 and Form 30?
faqs.answer: Form 29 is the 'Notice of Transfer of Ownership' which declares that the seller has handed over the vehicle. Form 30 is the 'Application for Transfer of Ownership' which requests the RTO to transfer the RC to the buyer's name.

faqs.question: Is NOC required if I transfer the vehicle within the same state?
faqs.answer: An NOC is only required if the buyer's address falls under a different RTO jurisdiction than the seller's RTO. If within the same local RTO, no NOC is needed.

faqs.question: Who is liable for accidents/fines after selling the vehicle but before RTO transfer?
faqs.answer: Legally, the registered owner (the seller) remains liable until the RTO records are updated. Therefore, sellers should ensure ownership transfer is completed immediately after sale.

name: Change of Address in DL / Vehicle RC
description: Official procedure to update residential address on Driving License (DL) or Vehicle Registration Certificate (RC) within 30 days of relocating.
prerequisites: Must hold an active DL or RC smart card and possess verified address proof for the new location.
common_steps: Log in to Parivahan Sewa portal (Sarathi for DL / Vahan for RC) using Aadhaar e-KYC.
Select 'Apply for Change of Address' and enter DL/RC number.
Upload valid address proof (Aadhaar Card, Passport, Utility Bill, or Voter ID).
Upload Form 33 (Notice of Change of Address) for vehicle RC updates.
Pay processing fee and smart card issue charges online.
Submit application via Aadhaar contactless mode or book an RTO slot for physical verification.
Receive updated smart card by speed post or view digital card on DigiLocker / mParivahan.

DL.fee_breakdown: Address Change: ₹200, Smart Card Fee: ₹200, Total: ₹400
DL.test_format: Contactless Online e-KYC via Aadhaar. Document verification completed digitally.
DL.special_note: Aadhaar address must match the target Delhi address for instant online approval.

MH.fee_breakdown: Application Fee: ₹150, Smart Card: ₹200, Postal Fee: ₹50, Total: ₹400
MH.test_format: Online application followed by physical document submission at local RTO.
MH.special_note: Original physical RC/DL smart card must be surrendered at the RTO counter.

KA.fee_breakdown: Application Fee: ₹150, Smart Card Fee: ₹137, Total: ₹287
KA.test_format: Online slot booking required for physical verification at local RTO.
KA.special_note: Requires NOC from prior RTO if moving across different RTO zones within Karnataka.

UP.test_format: Contactless Aadhaar mode enabled across major RTOs (Noida, Ghaziabad, Lucknow).
UP.special_note: Form 33 copy must be uploaded in PDF format for vehicle RC address changes.

TN.test_format: Online application with mandatory RTO visit for physical verification.
TN.special_note: Requires local municipal address proof if Aadhaar bears an out-of-state address.

TS.test_format: T-App Folio and RTA Citizen Portal e-KYC integrated.
TS.special_note: Instant processing available for Aadhaar linked TS residents.

GJ.test_format: Digital Gujarat RTO portal Aadhaar e-KYC process.
GJ.special_note: Physical card delivered by India Post speed post within 10 working days.

documents: Form 33 (Application for Notice of Change of Address)
Original Driving License or RC Smart Card
General.additional_notes: Must be filed within 30 days of address change to avoid late fee penalties.

Senior.additional_notes: Senior citizens can request priority queue processing at physical RTO counters.

documents: Aadhaar Card of Commercial License Holder
Fitness Certificate & Road Tax clearance receipt
Form 33 signed by Fleet Owner / Transport Authority
Commercial.additional_notes: Commercial vehicle address updates require clearance from the regional transport authority.

faqs.question: What is the penalty for delay in reporting address change on vehicle RC?
faqs.answer: Failing to report address change within 30 days incurs a monthly penalty fee of ₹300 for two-wheelers and ₹500 for cars under Section 177 of the Motor Vehicles Act.

faqs.question: Do I need a new Smart Card when updating my address?
faqs.answer: Yes. Once the address change is approved, a fresh smart card embedded with updated microchip data is issued and posted to your new address.

name: No Objection Certificate (NOC) for Vehicle Transfer
description: Official clearance certificate issued by the home RTO permitting the re-registration of a vehicle in another state or RTO jurisdiction.
prerequisites: Vehicle must have clear title with no pending traffic challans, crime records, or bank loan defaults.
common_steps: Apply online on Vahan Parivahan portal under 'Application for NOC'.
Enter vehicle registration number and chassis number.
Pay NOC processing fee online.
Obtain Police Crime Record Clearance Certificate from local Traffic/Crime Branch.
Pencil print of vehicle Chassis Number on physical Form 28 (3 copies).
Submit Form 28, Original RC, Insurance, PUC, and Police Clearance at the issuing RTO.
Upon verification, RTO issues NOC document valid for re-registration in target state.

DL.fee_breakdown: NOC Fee: ₹100 per vehicle class, Postal Fee: ₹50, Total: ₹150
DL.test_format: Online application submission followed by physical document audit at RTO.
DL.special_note: Delhi NCR 10-year diesel / 15-year petrol de-registered vehicles must obtain NOC for outside states.

MH.fee_breakdown: NOC Application Fee: ₹100, Service Fee: ₹50, Total: ₹150
MH.test_format: Physical chassis pencil imprint verification required at RTO counter.
MH.special_note: NCRB and local police crime branch NOC clearance required.

KA.test_format: Slot booking for RTO verification required.
KA.special_note: Karnataka requires road tax clearance certificate before granting NOC.

UP.test_format: Online portal filing with physical RTO verification.
UP.special_note: Clearance of all UP traffic e-challans is strictly enforced.

TN.test_format: RTO counter submission of Form 28 imprints.
TN.special_note: Police clearance required from Greater Chennai Police / District Crime Branch.

TS.test_format: Online filing on RTA portal + physical document verification.

GJ.test_format: Digital Gujarat upload + physical RTO inspection.
GJ.special_note: Pencil chassis imprint mandatory on 3 Form 28 copies.

documents: Form 28 (Application & Grant of NOC - 3 copies with pencil chassis imprints)
Valid Insurance Policy Certificate & PUC Certificate
Police Clearance Certificate (PCC) / Crime Branch NOC
Receipt of up-to-date Road Tax payment
General.additional_notes: Ensure all pending e-challans are paid before applying.

Commercial.additional_notes: Commercial vehicles must surrender state goods/passenger permits.

faqs.question: What is the validity period of an RTO NOC?
faqs.answer: An RTO NOC does not have a strict expiry date on paper, but it is expected to be submitted for re-registration in the target state within 6 months. Delay may require a re-validation certificate from the issuing RTO.

faqs.question: Can an issued NOC be cancelled if I decide not to sell/transfer the vehicle?
faqs.answer: Yes. You must obtain a 'Non-Utilization Certificate' (NUC) from the target state RTO confirming the vehicle was not registered there, and submit it back to the original home RTO to cancel the NOC.

name: Hypothecation Deletion / Addition (Bank Loan Closure)
description: Procedure to add bank lien when taking a vehicle loan or remove hypothecation from the RC smart card after full loan repayment.
prerequisites: Must have closed the vehicle bank loan and received official Bank NOC & Form 35.
common_steps: Collect Bank NOC letter and 2 signed copies of Form 35 from lending bank.
Access Vahan Parivahan portal under 'Hypothecation Deletion'.
Enter Vehicle Registration Number and last 5 digits of Chassis Number.
Upload Bank NOC, Form 35 (signed by bank & owner), PUC, and Insurance.
Pay Hypothecation Deletion Fee online.
Submit application via Aadhaar e-KYC contactless mode or visit local RTO with original documents.
Receive updated clear RC Smart Card without bank endorsement.

DL.fee_breakdown: HP Deletion Fee: ₹100 (2-Wheeler) / ₹200 (Car), Smart Card: ₹200, Total: ₹300-₹400
DL.special_note: Bank NOC digital verification integrated for major nationalized banks.

MH.fee_breakdown: HP Deletion: ₹500, Smart Card: ₹200, Postal Fee: ₹50, Total: ₹750
MH.test_format: Online filing followed by physical submission of original Form 35 at RTO.
MH.special_note: Both copies of Form 35 must bear original official bank seal.

KA.fee_breakdown: HP Deletion: ₹100 (2W) / ₹200 (4W), Smart Card Fee: ₹137, Total: ₹237-₹337
KA.test_format: Online slot booking for document verification at RTO.
KA.special_note: Bank NOC validity must be within 3 months of application date.

UP.fee_breakdown: HP Deletion Fee: ₹200, Smart Card: ₹200, Total: ₹400
UP.test_format: Contactless mode available with digital Form 35 upload.
UP.special_note: Ensure bank loan account number matches NOC letter.

TN.test_format: RTO counter submission of original Form 35.
TN.special_note: Original RC smart card must be surrendered for card printing.

TS.special_note: Digital verification with major regional bank portals.

GJ.special_note: Speed post delivery of clean RC smart card.

documents: Bank No-Objection Certificate (NOC) for loan closure
Form 35 (Notice of Termination of Hypothecation - 2 copies signed by bank)
General.additional_notes: Bank NOC letter is generally valid for 3 months from date of issue.

documents: Commercial Vehicle Fitness & Road Tax Clearance
Commercial.additional_notes: Financier endorsement must be cancelled before renewing commercial state permit.

faqs.question: What happens if bank NOC expires before submitting HP deletion application?
faqs.answer: You must request your bank to issue a re-validated NOC letter or fresh NOC with an updated issue date before applying on Parivahan.

faqs.question: Is HP deletion mandatory after finishing car loan payments?
faqs.answer: Yes. Until HP deletion is recorded in RTO Vahan database, the bank remains registered as legal hypothecator, preventing vehicle sale, RC transfer, or scrap clearance.

name: Vehicle Fitness Certificate & Renewal
description: Mandatory statutory inspection and certification confirming commercial transport vehicles (or private vehicles older than 15 years) comply with safety and emission roadworthiness standards.
prerequisites: Vehicle must be presented physically at the automated vehicle testing station / RTO track with valid PUC and Insurance.
common_steps: Apply online on Vahan Parivahan portal under 'Application for Fitness Certificate'.
Enter vehicle registration number and pay fitness inspection fee & smart card charges.
Book an appointment slot at the designated RTO Inspection Track / Automated Testing Station (ATS).
Ensure vehicle has working brakes, lights, speed governor, reflector strips, and valid PUC.
Present vehicle physically for inspector evaluation and chassis number verification.
Upon passing inspection, Fitness Certificate (Form 38) is granted online and endorsed on RC.

DL.test_format: Automated Testing Station (ATS) computerised track inspection.
DL.special_note: Speed governor and FASTag verification mandatory before testing.

MH.test_format: Physical inspection track testing by Motor Vehicle Inspector (MVI).
MH.special_note: Reflector strips (yellow/red) and emergency exit check enforced for passenger buses.

KA.test_format: RTO inspection track test by senior MVI inspector.
KA.special_note: Strict check on vehicle body dimensions and emission PUC levels.

UP.test_format: Automated track testing at regional ATS centers.
UP.special_note: Vehicle body paint and commercial lettering standards checked.

TN.special_note: Fire extinguisher and first aid box mandatory for commercial cabs.

TS.special_note: GPS vehicle tracking device check for commercial passenger cabs.

GJ.test_format: RTO track test by Motor Vehicle Inspector.
GJ.special_note: Reflective tape stickers mandatory as per CMVR rules.

documents: Receipt of paid Road Tax & State Transport Permit
Calibration Certificate for Speed Limiting Device (SLD)
Commercial.additional_notes: Commercial vehicle fitness is valid for 2 years for vehicles up to 8 years old, and 1 year thereafter.

faqs.question: What is the penalty for driving a commercial vehicle without a valid Fitness Certificate?
faqs.answer: Under Section 192 of the Motor Vehicles Act, driving an un-fit vehicle attracts a fine of ₹2,000 to ₹5,000 for first offence, and up to ₹10,000 for subsequent offences, along with impounding of the vehicle.

faqs.question: How long is a private vehicle fitness valid?
faqs.answer: Private vehicles receive fitness approval for 15 years upon initial registration. After 15 years, private vehicle fitness must be renewed every 5 years.
